title: Advanced Model Capability Tests
summary: This module contains integration tests designed to validate the advanced capabilities of various AI models, including audio processing, text embeddings, image generation, and multi-modal vision understanding. It ensures models perform as expected across diverse inputs and scenarios.

nodes.label: Test Audio Transcription
nodes.title: Audio Transcription Test
nodes.description: Verifies that models can accurately transcribe spoken audio provided as input within a chat request, expecting specific keywords in the transcription.

nodes.label: Test Audio Response
nodes.title: Audio Input Response Test
nodes.description: Evaluates models' ability to generate a coherent text response based on audio input, checking for relevant keywords in the generated text.

nodes.label: Test OpenAI Audio Transcription
nodes.title: OpenAI Audio Transcription API Test
nodes.description: Tests the server's OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/transcriptions` endpoint, sending audio via multipart form and verifying transcription accuracy.

nodes.label: Test OpenAI Chat with Audio
nodes.title: OpenAI Chat with Audio Input Test
nodes.description: Validates the server's OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint with base64-encoded audio input, checking for expected keywords in the chat response.

nodes.label: Test Embedding Cosine Correlation
nodes.title: Embedding Cosine Correlation Test
nodes.description: Assesses the quality of embedding models by calculating cosine similarities and Euclidean/Manhattan distances between related and unrelated text pairs, ensuring consistency.

nodes.label: Test All-MiniLM Embeddings (Old API)
nodes.title: All-MiniLM Embeddings Test (Legacy)
nodes.description: Verifies the output of the 'all-minilm' embedding model using an older API endpoint, checking the dimension and specific values of the generated embedding.

nodes.label: Test All-MiniLM Embed
nodes.title: All-MiniLM Single Embedding Test
nodes.description: Confirms the functionality of the 'all-minilm' embedding model for single text inputs, validating the embedding vector's size and numerical accuracy.

nodes.label: Test All-MiniLM Batch Embed
nodes.title: All-MiniLM Batch Embedding Test
nodes.description: Checks the batch embedding capability of the 'all-minilm' model, ensuring correct processing of multiple text inputs and validating the generated embeddings.

nodes.label: Test Embedding Status Codes
nodes.title: Embedding API Error Status Code Test
nodes.description: Tests the embedding API's error handling, specifically verifying that appropriate 4xx status codes are returned for requests exceeding context length when truncation is disabled.

nodes.label: Test Embedding Truncation
nodes.title: Embedding Truncation Behavior Test
nodes.description: Examines how embedding models handle input truncation, ensuring that batch requests with truncation enabled process inputs correctly and token counts remain within limits.

nodes.label: Test Embedding Large Input
nodes.title: Embedding Large Input Test
nodes.description: Evaluates the stability and performance of embedding models when processing progressively larger text inputs, confirming successful embedding generation.

nodes.label: Test All-MiniLM Embed Truncation Logic
nodes.title: All-MiniLM Truncation Logic Test
nodes.description: Performs detailed tests on the 'all-minilm' model's truncation logic, covering various `num_ctx` and `truncate` settings to ensure correct behavior and error handling for context limits.

nodes.label: Test Image Generation
nodes.title: Image Generation & Vision Verification Test
nodes.description: Tests the end-to-end image generation process: generating an image from a prompt using one model, then using a vision model to describe the generated image and verify its content.

nodes.label: Test Vision Models
nodes.title: Vision Model Text Recognition Test
nodes.description: Verifies the ability of various vision models to recognize and extract text from an image, checking for specific keywords in the model's response.

nodes.label: Test Vision Split Batch
nodes.title: Vision Model Batching Test
nodes.description: Examines how vision models handle large text prompts combined with image input, specifically testing the batching mechanism to ensure proper processing.

nodes.label: Test Vision Multi-Turn
nodes.title: Multi-Turn Vision Conversation Test
nodes.description: Assesses vision models' conversational capabilities by engaging in a multi-turn dialogue about an image, including follow-up questions on details and counts.

nodes.label: Test Vision Object Counting
nodes.title: Vision Model Object Counting Test
nodes.description: Tests vision models' accuracy in counting specific objects within an image, expecting a numerical or textual count in the response.

nodes.label: Test Vision Scene Understanding
nodes.title: Vision Model Scene Understanding Test
nodes.description: Evaluates vision models' ability to understand the context and cultural references within an image, checking for recognition of famous scenes or parodies.

nodes.label: Test Vision Spatial Reasoning
nodes.title: Vision Model Spatial Reasoning Test
nodes.description: Probes vision models' capacity for spatial reasoning by asking questions about the actions or positions of subjects in different parts of an image.

nodes.label: Test Vision Detail Recognition
nodes.title: Vision Model Detail Recognition Test
nodes.description: Checks vision models' ability to identify and describe fine details within an image, such as specific accessories worn by characters.

nodes.label: Test Vision Multi-Image
nodes.title: Vision Model Multi-Image Input Test
nodes.description: Tests vision models' capability to process and compare multiple images simultaneously, identifying commonalities and differences between them.

nodes.label: Test Vision Image Description
nodes.title: Vision Model Image Description Test
nodes.description: Verifies vision models' general image description capabilities, expecting a brief summary of the main subjects and actions depicted in an image.

nodes.label: Test Model Capability Check
nodes.title: Server Model Capability Check Test
nodes.description: Internal server test that verifies the `CheckCapabilities` method correctly identifies whether a model supports specific functionalities (e.g., tools, vision, embedding, image generation) based on its configuration and metadata.

nodes.label: Test Model Capabilities
nodes.title: Server Model Capability Determination Test
nodes.description: Internal server test that validates the `Capabilities` method, ensuring it accurately determines and lists all supported functionalities for a given model based on its architecture, configuration, and template.

nodes.label: Ollama Server
nodes.title: Ollama Core Server
nodes.description: The main Ollama server application, which hosts and serves various AI models, including chat, embedding, vision, and image generation capabilities.

nodes.label: OpenAI Compatible API
nodes.title: OpenAI Compatible API Endpoint
nodes.description: An API endpoint that mimics the OpenAI API specification, used for testing compatibility with external tools and services, particularly for audio transcription and chat with audio.

Sends multi-turn chat requests with image
Sends chat request with multiple images

groups.label: Audio Capability Tests
groups.title: Audio Capability Tests
groups.description: Tests verifying models' ability to process and respond to audio inputs, including transcription and chat with audio.

groups.label: Embedding Capability Tests
groups.title: Embedding Capability Tests
groups.description: Tests validating the generation and quality of text embeddings, covering various input sizes, batching, truncation, and error handling.

groups.label: Vision Capability Tests
groups.title: Vision Capability Tests
groups.description: Tests assessing models' image understanding, including text recognition, object counting, scene understanding, spatial reasoning, detail recognition, multi-image processing, and multi-turn conversations.

groups.label: Image Generation Capability Tests
groups.title: Image Generation Capability Tests
groups.description: Tests the end-to-end process of generating images from text prompts and verifying the generated content using a vision model.

groups.label: Server Model Capability Logic Tests
groups.title: Server Model Capability Logic Tests
groups.description: Internal tests for the server's logic in determining and checking the capabilities of loaded models based on their configuration and metadata.
